newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein dips slightly, no fresh leads.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein dips slightly, no fresh leads.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices dipped in late morning trading on Friday as the market drifted on a lack of fresh leads, traders said.
They said palm oil fell to 1,375-80 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, against 1,385 rupiah at the close on Thursday.
Crude palm oil was stable at 1,175-80 rupiah/kg in the North Sumatran city of Medan.
"It's very quiet today and buying interest is thin. The market seems to be losing direction amid bearish sentiment," one trader said.
Traders said they were expecting demand to improve later in the afternoon, but added that the weak Malaysian market had dampened local sentiment.
Dealers in Malaysia said weak Chicago soyoil values on Thursday had depressed sentiment, and that a rebound could only come from technical and speculative buying.
Data from Belawan port showed that the M.T. Bukit I will leave the North Sumatran port on Saturday with 1,000 tonnes of palm olein for Tanjung Priok in Jakarta.
